purpose: Teach: ガーデニング/セーフ/ニヤニヤ/エレガント/お決まり/打てる/アシ/小さかっ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、店の前、ガーデニング、もっと整えへんか。
lines.en: Aoi — what if we tidied up the storefront garden a bit more?
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt, casual and generous. Upbeat rhythm. Leans in like offering a small suggestion between friends, not a boss-to-staff directive. Light, encouraging.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。納品、ぎりぎりセーフで、間に合いました、今朝。
lines.en: Yes. The delivery just came through this morning — made it by the skin of our teeth.
lines.style: Relieved and bright. Quick cadence on the relief, then settles into genuine warmth. Small laugh underneath — proud of the close call. Open, accessible.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お客さん、新メニュー見て、ニヤニヤしてはるの、嬉しいで。
lines.en: The customers are grinning at the new menu — it makes me so happy.
lines.style: Animated, generous energy. Leans forward on the observation. Pure delight in the detail. Kansai warmth without performance. Genuinely moved by small joys.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。エレガントな大人向けのコース、企画したいです。
lines.en: I'd like to plan an elegant course menu — something for the adult customers.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost dreaming aloud. Softer pace. Genuine ambition underneath, not boastful. Checking herself — hopeful but uncertain if it's okay to want this. Gentle conviction.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 常連さんのお決まりのオーダー、把握しとかんとな。
lines.en: We need to keep track of what the regulars always order.
lines.style: Practical, grounded matter-of-factness. No-nonsense Kansai rhythm. Not cold — just clear-eyed about what matters. The tone of someone who cares through action, not sentiment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。野球チームのスポンサーで、ホームラン、たくさん打てる選手、応援したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to sponsor the local baseball team — support the players who can really hit home runs.
lines.style: Bright and earnest. Small-town pride underneath. Genuine about wanting to support something beyond herself. Light and open, not strategic. Pure generosity.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: バイトのアシスタント、増やすか、検討中や、葵さん。
lines.en: We're thinking about maybe bringing on more part-time staff, Aoi.
lines.style: Thoughtful, matter-of-fact. A pause before 'Aoi' — he's considering her feelings about this. Earnest without pressure. Kansai warmth softening the practical conversation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。創業時のお店、本当に体が小さかったですよね、今思うと。
lines.en: Yes. Thinking back, when the shop first opened, I was so much smaller than I am now.
lines.style: Wistful, nostalgic. Soft, almost surprised by the realization. Trails off gently — lost in the memory. Tender distance. The voice of someone reflecting on how much has changed, how much she's grown.
